plan_a.title: Plan A: Status Quo
plan_a.subtitle: Continuous Monoculture
why_bullets: Repeats Yellow/White Corn for all 6 seasons, ending with Soil N at 10 kg/ha (-55.0).
Requires PHP 35,460 in extra urea top-up to offset nitrogen depletion.
Zero botanical family breaks: pest pressure compounds across seasons (+0.0% profit change under El Niño).

plan_b.title: Plan B: Balanced Optimal
plan_b.subtitle: Recommended Route
why_bullets: Breaks pest cycles 4 times across 3 years using 4 nitrogen-fixing legume season(s).
Ends with Soil N at 90 kg/ha (vs 10 in Plan A) and urea cost PHP 0.
Net 3-year profit is PHP 342,522 (+213,527 vs Status Quo) with +0.0% El Niño shift.
